name: warn_explicit
reason: pyWarnExplicit omits the failure paths at the head of the body: int(lineno) on a non-int (:559), str(message) and category(message) raising (:560-565, a callback C runs later and only when module is not None), and registry.get on a non-dict registry; linecache.getlines and WarningMessage(...) are folded into the show callback.
